statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to optimize rate control management
The diagnosis code for sick sinus syndrome is I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols
